artifacts.notes: Complete provider PDF retained byte-for-byte. Registration inspection is bounded to PDF pages 1–5, 9 and 296–300, with title and colophon read in page images. The outer pages are historical covers and flyleaves; no separate Google usage-guidelines page was observed in those inspected bounds. Provider marks, if present elsewhere, remain unaltered and are not counted as historical book text. The embedded optical text is not a checked transcription and is not registered for raw-line search. Possession of 300 PDF pages does not establish every original leaf's survival, complete text coverage or full-book collation.
artifacts.rights_basis: Historical 1594 printing, public domain in the United States by expired publication term. Internet Archive item bub_gb_5Eqy8WGF9aQC identifies the delivery with Public Domain Mark 1.0 (item and metadata checked 2026-10-16), https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/. This provider assessment is recorded separately from the historical printing's publication-term basis. The exact mechanical scan is retained without alteration; any provider marks remain in the bytes. The repository's treatment of incidental Google matter is recorded in src/sources/inventories/google-usage-guidelines-rights-v1.toml. No modern critical edition or scholarly commentary is imported. edition.authority: Latin title at PDF page 5 says Permissu superiorum. The Latin colophon at PDF page 296 names Clement VIII, Cardinal protector Gabriele Paleotti and Maronite Patriarch Sergio Rizio; the following approbation names Thomas de Terracina, O.P. These printed permission and attribution statements are not a reconstructed promulgation history.
